title: Nonnegativity of the long-path indicator sum
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, let a finite list of paths on the $n$-coordinate binary cube be given, and let $x$ be a point of that cube. The sum, over listed paths of length greater than $k$, of their path indicators at $x$ is nonnegative.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of paths on the $n$-coordinate binary cube
$x$ is a point of the binary cube
